name: traice-sdk-monorepo
description: Public SDKs and coding-agent collectors for trAIce.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @traice/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @traice/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @traice/collector run build && pnpm run docs:build
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run release-notes:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run python:check && pnpm run pack:check && pnpm run public:verify && pnpm run docs:verify
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --filter @traice/protocol pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @traice/collector pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @traice/sdk pack --dry-run
scripts.python:check: cd packages/python && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && python3 -m compileall -q src
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @traice/protocol run test && pnpm --filter @traice/collector run test && pnpm --filter @traice/sdk run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @traice/protocol run typecheck && pnpm --filter @traice/collector run typecheck && pnpm --filter @traice/sdk run typecheck && pnpm --filter @traice/docs run typecheck
scripts.release: pnpm run check && pnpm exec changeset publish
